arguments.content: An intermediate 'applied' recovery status does not prove that the latest retry payload is active when callers may edit a failed request. If downstream receipt persistence fails after an idempotent provider write, a subsequent retry must reconcile the latest submitted values before reporting success. Skipping the write solely because status is 'applied', or replaying an old payload snapshot, acknowledges stale state. Exercise failure after apply, then retry the same operation ID with changed values. Verified in service.py: staged code completes the receipt with old preferences; HEAD applies the edited payload.
